APPROVE

The extraction preserves behavior (a mixed pair always yields a nonzero -1 or 1, which the caller's `c != 0` check returns just as the old direct return did), and it removes the if/else-if/else chain from `Compare`, which lowers its cognitive complexity below 15. The new private static helper introduces no obvious build or warning problems. I couldn't build the project or check for an existing `CompareSegment` name, so that part rests on reading the diff.
